exposure: KULEA-NET app features, content, and delivery methods
outcome: Preferences and acceptability of KULEA-NET app features, content, and delivery methods
Key social branding elements for the KULEA-NET app
cohort: The study included 24 Black or African American mothers who were potential users of a mobile health intervention for human milk feeding.
finding: Participants identified desired app content (peer support, expert access, geolocation, tracking), delivery methods, functionality (content diversity, ease of use, credibility, interactivity), and appealing social branding elements for an expanded KULEA-NET app designed to increase human milk feeding.
